sections.title: Unit 5: Urban Satire as Political Defense
body: In Budapest, humor is not entertainment; it is an institution, a trench, and an invisible republic of freedom. The 'pesti vicc' (Budapest political joke), the literary cabaret, and coffee-house wit dismantled authoritarian regimes from within.

In this unit, you will explore the anatomy of urban satire: Frigyes Karinthy's brilliant literary parodies, Endre Nagy's and Géza Hofi's fearless cabaret monologues, Cold War samizdat humor, and the continuation of urban satire in modern meme culture.
